title: The sets of points of algebraic stacks carry a unique topology continuous for every morphism and open for flat lfp maps from spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter properties.tex (Properties of Algebraic Stacks)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-properties.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Construct the topology via a presentation: W is open iff |p|^{-1}(W) is open for one surjective flat lfp p : U -> X; prove independence of p by forming U'' = U x_X U' and using that the two legs are fppf with open continuous point maps (lemma-property-spaces-too + fppf-open); prove continuity of |f| for any morphism via the lift-morphism-presentations diagram and the definition; prove openness for flat lfp U -> X via the three-diagram argument (points-cartesian surjectivity of the top left arrow, fppf-open of d∘e, and the displayed identity b^{-1}(a(W)) = (d∘e)(f^{-1}(W))).
